help_v2_playback_description: Playback, track navigation and repeat controls.

help_v2_audio_description: Volume, speed, pitch and audio effect profiles.

help_v2_requires_server: Use this command in a server. Read-only actions do not change playback.
help_v2_requires_voice: Use this command in a server and join a voice channel. Playback changes may also require an active player or current track.
help_v2_requires_manage_server: Server only. Viewing settings does not require a player; changing them requires Manage Server permission.
help_v2_requires_persistent_voice: Server only. Enabling requires voice membership. Text without an argument shows status; slash requires enabled:true or enabled:false.
help_v2_requires_favorite: Favorites belong to your user. Adding without a query needs a current track; playing a favorite requires a valid voice connection.
help_v2_requires_audio: Inspect the current player without changing it. Changes require voice membership in the bot's channel and supported audio controls.
help_v2_requires_autoplay: Server only. Status does not change playback; switching autoplay on or off requires an active player and membership in the bot's voice channel.
help_v2_requires_filters: Changes to active effects require the bot's voice channel. Saving, overwriting or deleting shared server profiles requires Manage Server permission.
help_v2_requires_skip: Join the bot's voice channel. When voting is enabled, the track requester and DJs skip directly; other listeners vote. When disabled, skip directly.
help_v2_requires_skipto: Join the bot's voice channel. With vote skip enabled, only the current track requester or DJ can jump directly; other listeners must use skip to vote.
